summary: Holds COVID location-level daily snapshot counts; grain = one row per (province_state, country_region, date) with keys province_state, country_region, date, latitude, longitude, location_geom and measures confirmed, deaths, recovered, active, fips, admin2, combined_key.
confirmed_cases: Holds time-series of confirmed COVID cases by location; grain = one row per (province_or_state, country_or_region) with location columns province_or_state, country_or_region, latitude, longitude, location_geom and daily measure columns _1_22_20 through _2_25_20 representing confirmed counts on each date.
recovered_cases: Holds time-series of recovered COVID cases by location; grain = one row per (province_or_state, country_or_region) with location columns province_or_state, country_or_region, latitude, longitude, location_geom and daily measure columns _1_22_20 through _2_25_20 representing recovered counts on each date.
deaths: Holds time-series of COVID deaths by location; grain = one row per (province_or_state, country_or_region) with location columns province_or_state, country_or_region, latitude, longitude, location_geom and daily measure columns _1_22_20 through _2_25_20 representing death counts on each date.
population_by_country: Holds historical country population counts; grain = one row per country (country, country_code) with year-specific measures year_1960 through year_1997 representing population in each year.
series_summary: Holds metadata about statistical series; grain = one row per series_code with key series_code and descriptive fields topic, indicator_name, short_definition, long_definition, unit_of_measure, periodicity, base_period, other_notes, aggregation_method, limitations_and_exceptions, notes_from_original_source, general_comments, source, statistical_concept_and_methodology, development_relevance, related_source_links, other_web_links, related_indicators, license_type.
country_series_definitions: Maps series codes to country-specific descriptions; grain = one row per (country_code, series_code) with keys country_code, series_code and description field.
series_times: Holds year-level descriptions for series codes; grain = one row per (series_code, year) with keys series_code, year and a description for that year.
country_summary: Holds country-level metadata and classification; grain = one row per country with key country_code and fields short_name, table_name, long_name, two_alpha_code, currency_unit, special_notes, region, income_group, wb_2_code, national_accounts_base_year, national_accounts_reference_year, sna_price_valuation, lending_category, other_groups, system_of_national_accounts, alternative_conversion_factor, ppp_survey_year, balance_of_payments_manual_in_use, external_debt_reporting_status, system_of_trade, government_accounting_concept, imf_data_dissemination_standard, latest_population_census, latest_household_survey, source_of_most_recent_income_and_expenditure_data, vital_registration_complete, latest_agricultural_census, latest_industrial_data, latest_trade_data.
health_nutrition_population: Holds country-year indicator observations for health/nutrition/population; grain = one row per (country_name or country_code, indicator_code, year) with keys country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code and measures value and year.
international_debt: Holds country-year indicator observations for international debt; grain = one row per (country_name or country_code, indicator_code, year) with keys country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code and measures value and year.
international_education: Holds country-year indicator observations for international education; grain = one row per (country_name or country_code, indicator_code, year) with keys country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code and measures value and year.
footnotes: Holds footnote text for specific data points; grain = one row per (country_code, series_code, year); notable columns/keys = country_code, series_code, year, description
series_time: Holds time-series-level notes; grain = one row per (series_code, year); notable columns/keys = series_code, year, description
indicators_data: Holds indicator observations by country and year; grain = one row per (country_name, country_code, indicator_code, year) representing one observed value; notable columns/keys/measures = country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year, value
